Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on your earlier commitments: are story 3, story 4, and task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12? Please share what you’ve finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.
Regarding task 19 possibly slipping, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Thanks, Daniel.
Maya, is story 5 done and is bug 12 done, and what did you finish, what’s next, and anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for the blocker on access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with Daniel on staging access today.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker, waiting on the security review, and your commitment to chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, is task 14 done from your earlier “finish it tomorrow” commitment, and is story 1 done from yesterday’s “keep working on the payment retry story” commitment? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Keep working on the payment retry story today.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, given the sandbox was down?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment to sync with Maya after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised were: task 19 will be flagged if it slips, access to the platform team’s staging gateway, waiting on the security review, and the sandbox being down. There is a parked side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts and configuration checks. Task 15 is stale and was not covered, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams. Thank you, everyone.
